text: Program Description 1. Training Goal Editor Notes: This program is designed to train students' language skills. To understand language through training of listening, speaking, reading and writing. To have a good knowledge of about 2000 new Chinese words, and about 180 language points. Be able to communicate in daily life and study and handle common language environment. To learn about the society of China in a general aspect. Students need to preview the text before the classes, take part in class actively, and finish homework after class. 2. Program Structure Editor Notes: This program includes 3 main courses and lots of elective courses. This program will be divied into three level, primary class, Intermediate class, advanced class according to students language level. Compulsory Courses Level Courses Primary (Zero I II) Primary Intensive Reading, Primary Spoken Chinese, Primary Chinese Listening Intermediate (I II) Intermediate Chinese Intensive Reading, Intermediate Spoken Chinese, Intermediate Chinese Listening, Modern Chinese Conversation, Intermediate Chinese Extensive Reading, Chinese Writing, Intermediate Chinese Grammar, Chinese Newspaper Reading, Translation Advanced (I II) Advanced Chinese Intensive Reading, Advanced Spoken Chinese, Advanced Chinese Listening, Modern Chinese Conversation, Advanced Chinese Extensive Reading, Chinese Writing, Advanced Chinese Grammar, Chinese Newspaper Reading, Translation Elective Course Chinese Calligraphy, Beijing Opera, Chinese Kung Fu, Chinese Medicine, Chinese Massage, Taijiquan, Traditional Chinese Painting, Economics & Trade, Chinese Science & Technology, Chinese Religions, Computer Processing, Chinese Cooking, Chinese Musical Instrument, Chinese Folk Songs Field Training Chinese Life Research, Chinese Language Contest, Visiting Cultural Performance (Folk Music, Chinese Movies, Beijing Opera, Chinese Fine Arts), Slightseeing Guest Lecture Chinese History, Traditional Customs, Chinese Economics, Chinese Calligraphy, Traditional Folk Music, Chinese Medicine, Acupunture, Chinese Martial Arts 3. School Introduction Editor Notes: Nankai University is a key multidisciplinary and research-oriented university. Nankai University is well known for its healthy environment. By attaching great importance to students' overall development in virtue, intelligence, sporting and art, the University has successfully created a colorful campus cultural atmosphere of elegance and aspiration for the benefit of the students' healthy growth. As a result, being equipped with strong basic knowledge, all-round capability, creativity and practical ability, graduates from Nankai University are extraordinarily popular with employers from all fields , Learn More>> 4. About the College of Chinese Language and Culture Editor Notes: Nankai University is one of only a few Chinese higher educational institutes to start admitting international students.  The College was placed as a testing site of Chinese proficiency, HSK, and the Certificate of Chinese Language Instructor for International Students. The College owns modern facilities with high quality. The College has an excellent teacher group, which contains 51 Chinese language teachers, of whom 6 are Professors, 20 are associate Professors and 23 lecturers. Lots of graduates have found jobs in their respective countries in political, economic, cultural, or educational fields. 5.
